jobGuard.interpretation: A push to main on any watched warmup path satisfies the physical job guard.

auditConclusion: P0 confirmed. Push-triggered physical warmup is a direct avoidable free-tier quota consumer and must be separated from test/read-only push validation.
requiredRemediation: Keep push trigger only for static/tests/planning/read-only evidence OR remove push from the physical workflow entirely.
Physical warmup may run only under schedule/manual flow after the shared account-level D1 quota budget gate authorizes it.
Regression must prove a push event cannot reach the Cloudflare credentialed physical mutation step.
Do not disable schedule/manual physical history warming outright; preserve bounded launch-critical history acquisition behind quota governance.
No paid-tier upgrade or billing mutation is authorized.
